LOS_OCCLUSION.description: Geometric line-of-sight occlusion only; propagation on visible cells.

DIFFRACTION_ASSISTED.description: Knife-edge diffraction assists shadowed cells (ITU-R P.526-15).

SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE.description: Adds a single specular ground-bounce contribution.

FREE_SPACE.description: Free-space path loss. Holds ordinal 0 and is the default.

CUSTOM.description: A model this enum cannot express; the solver names it out of band.

OK.description: Solve completed; every layer is present for every cell.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite where a value is required, or dimensionally inconsistent.

REFUSED.description: The solver does not implement the requested physics. ERROR_MESSAGE names the gap; NO layers are carried. A refusal is never a fallback.

TRSRequest.description:
One terrain raster solve request.

FRAMES. The analysis frame is a local East-North-Up (ENU) frame: local X
is east, Y is north, Z is up. Both grids share the same analysis-frame
bounds, anchored at (MIN_EAST_M, MIN_NORTH_M). Per-cell geodetic
coordinates are carried explicitly in GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD /
GRID_LATITUDE_RAD so a solver recomputes exact per-cell Earth-fixed
geometry instead of interpolating it.

PROFILE_WIDTH.description:
Obstruction profile field width, cells. The profile is a FINER field
than the output raster; the line-of-sight march samples it.

SOLVER_TIER.description:
Fidelity tier requested. A solver that does not implement the tier
REFUSES; it never silently downgrades.

LOS_OCCLUSION.description: Geometric line-of-sight occlusion only; propagation on visible cells.

DIFFRACTION_ASSISTED.description: Knife-edge diffraction assists shadowed cells (ITU-R P.526-15).

SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE.description: Adds a single specular ground-bounce contribution.

PROPAGATION_MODEL.description:
Propagation model requested for the per-cell loss term. A solver that
does not implement the model REFUSES; it never silently substitutes.

FREE_SPACE.description: Free-space path loss. Holds ordinal 0 and is the default.

CUSTOM.description: A model this enum cannot express; the solver names it out of band.

ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL_MASK.description:
Atmospheric attenuation terms requested, as a bitmask: 0 none,
bit 0 (1) gaseous absorption, bit 1 (2) rain attenuation, bit 2 (4)
cloud/fog attenuation. A solver that does not implement a requested
term REFUSES.

THREAD_COUNT_HINT.description:
Parallelism hint. 0 or 1 means sequential. A solver MUST produce
byte-identical layers at any value — cells are independent and a thread
writes only its own indices; determinism is part of this contract.

MIN_EAST_M.description: Analysis-frame east coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

MIN_NORTH_M.description: Analysis-frame north coordinate of the shared grid origin, meters.

PROFILE_SPACING_M.description: Profile sample spacing, meters; sets the line-of-sight march stride.

MINIMUM_STEP_M.description:
Minimum march step, meters. NaN means caller left it unset and the
solver applies its own documented default.

TX_LOCAL_X_M.description:
Emitter position in the analysis ENU frame, meters (X east, Y north,
Z up).

TX_ECEF_X_M.description:
Emitter Earth-centered Earth-fixed position, meters — carried so the
solver computes exact per-cell range rather than a small-angle
approximation.

TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M.description: Emitter height above the reference ellipsoid, meters.

TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.description:
Terrain surface height under the emitter, meters above the ellipsoid.
Emitter height above ground = TX_ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT_M −
TX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_M.

INVERSE_ENU_TRANSFORM.description:
Column-major 4x4 inverse of the analysis ENU frame transform (the
matrix that takes Earth-fixed points INTO the analysis frame). Exactly
16 entries.

TARGET_HEIGHT_M.description: Receiver height above ground at every cell, meters.

BANDWIDTH_HZ.description:
Noise bandwidth, hertz. NaN means caller left it unset and the solver
applies its own documented default.

TX_POWER_W.description: Transmit power, watts. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_GAIN_DBI.description: Transmit antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

TX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Transmit line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_GAIN_DBI.description: Receive antenna gain, dBi. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

RX_LINE_LOSS_DB.description:
Receive line loss, dB (positive). NaN means unset; solver default
applies.

RX_NOISE_FIGURE_DB.description: Receiver noise figure, dB. NaN means unset; solver default applies.

EFFECTIVE_EARTH_RADIUS_FACTOR.description:
Effective Earth radius factor (k-factor) for curvature correction.
NaN means no curvature term is applied — NOT a default of 4/3.

GRID_LONGITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic longitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GRID_LATITUDE_RAD.description:
Geodetic latitude of every output cell, radians, row-major,
GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

GROUND_HEIGHTS_M.description:
Terrain height at every output cell, meters above the ellipsoid,
row-major, GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_HEIGHTS_M.description:
COMPOSITE obstruction surface (terrain plus structures) at every
profile cell, meters above the ellipsoid, row-major,
PROFILE_WIDTH * PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

PROFILE_SURFACE_Z_M.description:
The same composite surface expressed as analysis-frame Z, meters —
the frame the line-of-sight test runs in. PROFILE_WIDTH *
PROFILE_HEIGHT entries.

TRSResult.description:
One terrain raster solve result. On STATUS = OK every layer below is
present with exactly GRID_WIDTH * GRID_HEIGHT row-major entries. On any
other STATUS the result carries NO layers — never a partial raster.

OK.description: Solve completed; every layer is present for every cell.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite where a value is required, or dimensionally inconsistent.

REFUSED.description: The solver does not implement the requested physics. ERROR_MESSAGE names the gap; NO layers are carried. A refusal is never a fallback.

ERROR_MESSAGE.description:
On REFUSED or INVALID_INPUT: names the exact gap or defect. Empty on
OK.

GRID_WIDTH.description:
Output raster dimensions the layers are stated for, echoed from the
request.

VISIBLE_MASK.description:
1 where the geometric ray from the emitter clears the obstruction
surface, else 0.

PATH_CLASS.description:
Path classification of every cell from the dominant-edge diffraction
parameter — see trsPathClass.

PATH_LOSS_DB.description: Total path loss including every applied term, dB (positive).

EXCESS_LOSS_DB.description: Loss above free space — what the terrain cost the cell, dB.

DIFFRACTION_PARAMETER.description:
ITU-R P.526-15 eq. (29) diffraction parameter v of the dominant edge.
Exactly -10.0 where no finite v exists (an unobstructed, Fresnel-clear
path) — the layer's stated no-finite-v encoding, carried verbatim so
the FlatBuffer and aligned-binary forms stay byte-comparable.

REFLECTION_CONTRIBUTION_DB.description:
Specular ground-bounce contribution, dB. All zeros outside the
SPECULAR_SINGLE_BOUNCE tier.

TRACE_ID.description:
Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when
present.
